Nonetheless, the view that the formality of putting a promise in writing 
should operate as an alternative to consideration continued to have some 
appeal among commentators, 
especially when the abolition of the seal 
raised the doctrine of consideration to even greater prominence. 
This appeal has not yielded much general legislation. In the 1920's,

State Laws

bound." This was enacted only in Pennsylvania 
and Utah, and was
